name: null_logic_beanquery_quirks
query: SELECT DISTINCT NOT NULL AS not_null, NULL AND FALSE AS null_and_false WHERE account = 'Expenses:Financial:Fees'
notes: beanquery quirks that DIFFER from SQL: NOT NULL is TRUE (SQL: NULL), and AND short-circuits on the first NULL operand, so NULL AND FALSE is NULL (SQL: FALSE; FALSE AND NULL is FALSE).
